description: Replace conventional plowing with zero-till seed drills for wheat and chickpea. Maintain crop residue as mulch cover.
Plant Sesbania or Dhaincha as green manure during fallow period. Incorporate before flowering to maximize N and C inputs.
Retain 60-70% of crop residue on fields. Use happy seeder for in-situ incorporation. Critical for Wardha cotton fields.
Apply 2-3 tonnes/ha compost or 0.5 t/ha biochar annually. Combine with vermicomposting of farm waste.
Plant Subabul or Moringa on field borders (5-8 trees/ha). Long-term SOC boost + additional income stream.
